roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our facility maintains the highest standards of health and safety. You will play a key role in developing and implementing educational programs for staff and managing our comprehensive infection control initiatives.This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about both staff development and public health. We offer a competitive hourly rate and the chance to make a significant impact on patient care and staff competency within a supportive environment. Join a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or infection control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of current infection prevention and control practices and regulatory guidelines
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP). This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to welcome you to our team. We are seeking a dedicated professional to provide essential speech and language services to our patients, contributing to their recovery and improved quality of life.As a PRN SLP, you will have the flexibility to manage your schedule while making a significant impact. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for a compassionate and skilled individual ready to deliver exceptional patient care within a supportive environment. If you are passionate about helping patients regain communication and swallowing abilities, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist (SLP)
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as needed) opportunity offers excellent flexibility, allowing you to balance your professional life with personal commitments while making a significant impact on patient recovery.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will play a crucial role in guiding patients through therapeutic exercises, providing education, and documenting their progress.

This role is ideal for a motivated professional eager to contribute to a supportive therapy team and provide exceptional care in a dynamic rehabilitation environment. Join us in empowering patients on their journey to recovery and independence.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) in Florida
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting is preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for PRN PTA is $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
